summary: Retest of collapsed-sidebar flyout fix (portal to document.body + position:fixed + viewport clamping) at 1920x800 with owner@palmhouse.com. All 7 requested scenarios PASS. Flyout is a direct child of BODY; elementFromPoint at flyout center hits flyout items in all cases, including on /settings with settings-panel (fixed, z-50) open. Insights flyout (38 items) bounded to viewport (bottom 792 < 800), inner list scrollable (scrollHeight 1960 / clientHeight 344), last item 'Food Court Beta' reachable after scroll. Only a minor UX issue found: clicking the same parent icon again does not close the flyout.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the same parent icon while its flyout is open does not close it (stays open). RCA: the document mousedown click-outside handler fires first (parent button is outside flyoutRef) and sets flyoutItem=null; then onClick -> handleItemClick sees flyoutItem null and reopens it. So the toggle branch at Sidebar.jsx L391 never runs. Fix: in the mousedown handler, ignore targets inside the aside / any [data-testid^='sidebar-'] parent button (e.g. keep an asideRef and skip if asideRef.current.contains(e.target)), or check e.target.closest('[data-flyout-trigger]').

action_items: (LOW) Make re-clicking the same collapsed-sidebar parent icon close its flyout (click-outside handler should ignore sidebar parent buttons).
(LOW, optional) top clamp Math.min(flyoutTop, innerHeight-400) becomes negative if viewport height < 400; wrap in Math.max(8, ...).
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx L721/L723/L735: window.innerHeight computed only at render; resizing the window while the flyout is open won't reposition it (minor).
Sidebar.jsx L721: fixed 400px clamp means short flyouts (e.g. Expenses) opened from lower icons get shifted up even if they'd fit — acceptable but could use measured height instead.
Sidebar.jsx is 901 lines (>700) — consider extracting the flyout into its own component.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-button; wait ~20s after login. Collapse/expand button testid 'expand-sidebar' when collapsed (changes when expanded). Flyout child testids: flyout-<childId> e.g. flyout-printers, flyout-profit-loss (-> /reports-module/profit-loss). Settings > Printers navigates to /settings with [data-testid=settings-panel] fixed z-50. Verified at 1920x800: Settings flyout top 400 bottom 731; Reports bottom 771; Insights bottom 792 with internal scroll; Reports on /settings overlay top 305, on top. Switching Settings->Insights directly works. Expanded (280px) shows inline children, no flyout.
